headline: Approved requests for building commissioner review of demolition ordinance amendments and for outreach to state and Preservation Massachusetts.
summary: The Commission reviewed draft amendments to the Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance, Title 4.24, proposed by the Chair. It also discussed hiring a Preservation Specialist, its budget, and available grants. The Commission confirmed Gerard Tannetta will attend the September 24, 2026 meeting and invited a Planning Board member to comment on the façade of 15 Ferry Street/One Salem Street.
decisions: Requested that Building Commissioner Nelson Miller review proposed Title 4.24 amendments on enforcement, Emergency Demolition, and Demolition by Neglect, and invite him to a meeting; motion passed 5-0.
Agreed to contact the state Historical Commission and Preservation Massachusetts about guidance and assistance; motion passed 5-0.
Confirmed Gerard Tannetta will attend the September 24, 2026 meeting and invited a Planning Board member to present comments on the façade of 15 Ferry Street/One Salem Street; motion passed 5-0.

Page 1 of 2 MHC 9/10/26 
   
 
 
 
          
           
    
 
 
MALDEN HISTORICAL COMMISSION 
MEETING MINUTES 
 
Date: Thursday, September 10, 2026 
Location: Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA, Room 108. 
Commissioners in attendance: Inna Babitskaya, Chair; Elizabeth Salazar, Vice Chair (attended remotely 
via Teams); Matthew Bach; Keith Jackson (attended remotely via Teams); Emma Taddeo; Leonard 
Iovino, Alternate.  
Commissioners absent: John Parcellin, Alternate. 
City Staff: Michelle Romero, Clerk to the Commission. 
 
       -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
Babitskaya called the meeting to order at 5:08 pm, took a roll call and chaired the meeting. 
 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
1. Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance, Title 4.24.  
The Commission reviewed and discussed draft amendments proposed by the Chair. 
 
The Commission will request Building Commissioner Nelson Miller to review the proposed 
amendments regarding enforcement, Emergency Demolition, Demolition by Neglect, and invite him 
to a meeting to discuss feedback. 
 
On the motion by Bach, seconded by Taddeo, five voted in favor, none in opposition, and the motion 
passed (5-0). (Bach, yes; Jackson, yes; Salazar, yes; Taddeo, yes; Babitskaya, yes; Iovino, Alternate, 
not voting; Parcellin, Alternate, absent). 
 
2. Other Business Properly Before the Commission. 
a. The Commission will contact the state Historical Commission regarding guidance and assistance 
available to the Commission; and will contact Preservation Massachusetts.   
 
On the motion by Salazar, seconded by Taddeo, five voted in favor, none in opposition, and the 
motion passed (5-0). (Bach, yes; Jackson, yes; Salazar, yes; Taddeo, yes; Babitskaya, yes; Iovino, 
Alternate, not voting; Parcellin, Alternate, absent). 
 
b. The Commission discussed hiring a Preservation Specialist who would provide on-call services to 
the Commission.  Romero will confirm that the Commission has the most current Mass Historic 
Preservation Directory. 
 
c. The Commission discussed its budget and grants that may be available. 
 
 
                                   
 
City of Malden 
Massachusetts 
 
MALDEN HISTORICAL COMMISSION 
 
215 Pleasant Street, Room 330  
Malden, Massachusetts 02148 
(781) 397-7000 ext. 2044
Page 2 of 2 MHC 9/10/26 
 
d. The Commission confirmed that Gerard Tannetta, Director, History/Social Studies Department, 
Malden High School will attend the September 24, 2026 meeting to discuss the Proposal for a 
School-Historical Commission Partnership to Advance Historic Preservation and Civic 
Engagement. 
 
e. Romero informed the Commission of a Planning Board member who is an architect and would 
like to submit comments to the Commission re: façade of 15 Ferry Street/One Salem Street. The 
Commission will invite this Planning Board member to the September 24, 2026 meeting to 
present her comments. 
On the motion by Taddeo, seconded by Salazar, five voted in favor, none in opposition, and the 
motion passed (5-0). (Bach, yes; Jackson, yes; Salazar, yes; Taddeo, yes; Babitskaya, yes; Iovino, 
Alternate, not voting; Parcellin, Alternate, absent). 
 
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
f. Next meeting:    September 24, 2026 at 5 pm.   
 
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
g. Adjournment: 6:53 pm.  On the motion of Bach, seconded by Taddeo, five voted in favor, none in 
opposition, and the motion passed (5-0). (Bach, yes; Jackson, yes; Salazar, yes, Taddeo, yes; 
Babitskaya, yes;  Iovino, Alternate, not voting; Parcellin, Alternate, absent). 
 
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
          
Inna Babitskaya, Chair
